messages:
Elena C: Quick pulse on QuantumBridge dedicated pool — seeing increased queueing overnight, can someone pull usage/saturation so we can prep for the renewal? https://dash.redwood/quantumbridge/gpu
Samir I: pulling now. quick numbers: last 24h GPU hours 1,120h (+18% w/w). peak pool saturation 87% at 02:10 UTC. queue depth peaked at 14 jobs. logs show scheduler backpressure.
Maya S: autoscale triggered a few times, but min_nodes=3 keeps baseline tight. small, short trainings are creating tail latency.
Max R: heads-up — QuantumBridge renewal in ~5w. if cost or latency keeps trending up that's a risk. need action plan + customer enablement.
capacity-bot: ASG scaled +2 nodes at 2026-03-15T02:15:12Z (trigger: high_saturation).
Samir I: here's a snippet of the scheduler log:
```
[2026-03-15T02:10:03Z] scheduler: backpressure=true queue_depth=14 avg_latency=210ms
[2026-03-15T02:10:18Z] autoscale: add_nodes=2 reason=peak_saturation
```
Elena C: thanks. proposed short-term mitigations: enable 20% burst capacity for 2 weeks, enable short-job preemption, and run a customer enablement session on improved batch sizes.
Maya S: agree. also recommend increasing GPU slot_preemption to 30% to free headroom for short jobs.
Samir I: I'll open ticket CS-4821 to track changes and will attach hourly CSV export. preliminary cost impact: if we maintain current peaks cost ~+$4.2k/mo. with +20% burst expected net +$1.1k/mo (because fewer queued jobs reduce wasted waiting time). I'll include a per-hour delta in the ticket.
Max R: great, please cc QuantumBridge AE and set a short enablement call next week. :thumbsup:
Elena C: can someone own outreach? @Max R can you coordinate with AE? I'll draft an enablement checklist.
Max R: yep I'll take outreach and schedule call. putting tentative slot for Tue 10am PT. :calendar:
Samir I: ticket created CS-4821. linking dashboard and CSV in the ticket.
Elena C: thanks all — let's reconvene next Mon for status and to approve burst window. :eyes:
